# UCI HAR sequence campaign: blocked

No held-out scores or completed replicates were produced. Epsilon 1, seed
20260922 reached the three actual DSLite nodes, which all aborted on:

```text
DSFLOWER SECURITY: package '_remote_module_non_scriptable' is not in pinned_packages.json (default-deny).
Aborting process.
```

The release guard rejects a module generated by the installed PyTorch runtime.
No guard/pin-map/package change or GRU attempt followed this shared import
failure. Epsilon 4/8 and remaining seeds were not run. The synthetic direct GPU
update in `preflight.json` passed outside the full node import guard; it is not
a HAR utility result. All utility metrics and acceptance diagnostics are null
or explicitly unevaluated. The test archive members were never read.

The planned cell is `pytorch_lstm`, 128 × 9 inertial windows, six activities,
three sites, five rounds, seeds 20260922–20260924, epsilon 1/4/8, delta 1e-6,
subject privacy and unit clipping, with registry defaults. TRAIN contains
7,352 windows from 21 subjects; site window counts are 2,553 / 2,397 / 2,402,
with seven subjects each. The release pools each subject's feature vectors and
modal class before DP-SGD. That limitation is declared in the frozen protocol.

Both packages are 0.5.0. Runner SHA-256:
`2135902bc710825b77b2f6a397c0040e051fe042fe1707b148b7e88ae71d2724`.
Host: RunPod `5abpdvx54g6uz2`, NVIDIA A40. R 4.6.1, Python 3.11.10,
torch 2.6.0+cu124, Opacus 1.6.0, Flower 1.31.0. The environment used cu124
for the supplied CUDA 12.4 image; this archive does not assert that every
permitted dependency combination fails.

`startup-attempts.json` preserves a prior 15-second SuperLink startup timeout
on network storage, before initialization. Moving unchanged dependencies to
local POSIX storage resolved startup; console interpreter paths were relocated
without changing Python bodies. The subsequent federation failure and each
node's log are archived separately. Both attempts cleaned up. The pod remains
running.

`summary.json` indexes one status record per planned epsilon. `runtime.json`,
`node-contract.json` and `initial-capture.json` preserve observed versions,
privacy contracts and public initialization/configuration. The full node-round
privacy/accountant captures are unavailable because no successful node round
was observed. `audit.json` contains training-only bounds, split and provenance.
See [tooling and reproduction](../../../../tools/campaign/sequence/README.md).

Dataset: [UCI HAR, id 240](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/240/human+activity+recognition+using+smartphones),
[official archive](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/240/human+activity+recognition+using+smartphones.zip),
